title: Update Homebrew packages to the latest versions
summary: Upgrade installed formulae and casks to their newest versions. You can update a specific package or all of them at once.

steps.explain: Upgrade a specific formula or cask. If no name is provided, all installed packages are upgraded.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the formula or cask to upgrade. Omit to upgrade all.

alternatives.explain: Upgrade all installed formulae and casks.

rollback.explain: Homebrew does not provide a simple undo command on this page. Downgrading requires manual intervention not covered here.

warnings: Upgrading packages can sometimes break dependencies or change behavior. It is good practice to update one package at a time if you are troubleshooting.
